## Synopsis

```text
Meziantou.Framework.PublicApiGenerator.Tool [options]
```

## Description

Generate public API stubs from a .NET assembly.

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--input <input> (REQUIRED)` | Assembly input. Use either 'path' or 'tfm=path'. Repeat for multi-target generation. |  |
| `--output <output>` | Output directory |  |
| `--output-file <output-file>` | Output file path when --file-layout is SingleFile |  |
| `--file-layout <OneFilePerNamespace\|OneFilePerType\|SingleFile>` | File layout: SingleFile, OneFilePerNamespace, or OneFilePerType | `SingleFile` |
| `--omit-auto-generated-comment` | Omit the // \<auto-generated/\> comment from generated files |  |
| `--verify-no-change` | Verify generated files are up to date without writing changes |  |
| `-?`, `-h`, `--help` | Show help and usage information |  |
| `--version` | Show version information |  |
